ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a light yellow shaded triangle, with the bottom side labeled 30 m. Attached to the right side of the triangle is a pink dashed right triangle; its horizontal leg is labeled 5 m, and the hypotenuse is labeled 10 m; the vertical side of this dashed right triangle is the same as the height of the shaded triangle. Reasoning: Use the right dashed right triangle to find the height of the shaded triangle. By the Pythagorean theorem, h = sqrt(10^2 - 5^2) = sqrt(100 - 25) = sqrt(75). The shaded triangle area A = (1/2)(30)(sqrt(75)) = 15sqrt(75) ≈ 129.9.

raw_record.question_text: Find the area of the triangle. Round to the nearest tenth if necessary.

method.method_draft: Read the shaded triangle's base as 30 m from the image. Also read the attached dashed right triangle on the right: its horizontal leg is 5 m and its slanted side is 10 m, while its vertical leg is the same vertical height as the shaded triangle. Use the Pythagorean theorem on the dashed right triangle to find the height: h = sqrt(10^2 - 5^2) = sqrt(75). Then compute the shaded triangle area with A = (1/2)(base)(height) = (1/2)(30)(sqrt(75)), and round to the nearest tenth.

method.method_draft: Read from the image that the shaded triangle has base 30 m. The dashed right triangle beside it has hypotenuse 10 m and horizontal leg 5 m, so the angle at the dashed triangle's rightmost base satisfies cos(theta) = 5/10 = 1/2. Therefore theta = 60 degrees, making the vertical shared height equal to 10 sin(60 degrees) = 5sqrt(3). Use this as the altitude of the shaded triangle, so area = (1/2)(30)(5sqrt(3)) = 75sqrt(3), then round to 129.9.

推理：根据右侧虚线直角三角形，设斜边与水平底边的夹角为 θ，则 cos(θ)=5/10=1/2，所以 θ=60°。共享的竖直高度为 10sin(60°)=10·√3/2=5√3 m。阴影三角形面积 = (1/2)·底·高 = (1/2)·30·5√3 = 75√3 ≈ 129.9。
